subject: OncoScale SIG follow-up: ephemeral inference logs and keystore disposal evidence
messages:
From: Samantha Lin <samantha@oncoscale.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@oncoscale.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up: ephemeral inference logs / keystore disposal

Diego — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Two quick asks from our security team as we move toward procurement: 

1) We need evidence showing how Redwood treats ephemeral inference logs (session prompts + outputs). Specifically: retention windows, examples of redaction/PII removal, and the list of storage locations (hosted vs. tenant-scoped ephemeral cache).

2) On keystore lifecycle: we asked if derived embeddings or intermediate keys are ever persisted outside of customer-managed KMS. If so, we need the disposal certification language your legal team can accept for our SOC/SIG review.

Can you share a short packet (SIG mapping + sample logs + certificate draft) we can attach to our internal SIG review? Preferably by EOD next Tuesday (Nov 30).

Appreciate it — Samantha

--
Samantha Lin
Director, Security & Privacy
OncoScale
From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lin <samantha@oncoscale.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: ephemeral inference logs / keystore disposal

Samantha — thanks for the clear ask. High level answers here and we'll attach the detailed artifacts: 

- Ephemeral inference logs: Redwood retains session-level inference logs used for debugging and quality checks for a default of 7 days for hosted customers. For Dedicated/Private customers we honor customer-configured retention; OncoScale (per our conversation) is scoped to 30 days for diagnostic traces. We automatically mask tokens that match sensitive patterns (PII regex set) before any retention.

- Storage: ephemeral logs are written to an encrypted tenant-scoped object store (AES-256) in the region where the request originated; prefix caching (KV) is in RAM-backed GPU nodes and not persisted beyond process lifecycle. For hosted customers we have a short-lived archival bucket for crash-forensics (retention 90 days, encrypted).

- Keystore: we do not persist customer master keys. Derived keys (session tokens used internally for caching) are ephemeral and rotated; nothing is persisted to an external key vault unless the customer opts-in to Redwood-managed KMS.

Irene — can you assemble the SIG mapping + redaction examples + a certificate draft for disposal that matches OncoScale's SOC asks? Marissa — please include a sample CSV with anonymized pseudo-rows from an inference trace.

Samantha — we'll aim to deliver the packet by Tue 2026-11-30 EOD. If you need the DocuSign language embedded sooner, flag it and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Security Lead, Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lin <samantha@oncoscale.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: ephemeral inference logs / keystore disposal

Hi Samantha — attaching the first draft of the evidence pack (see attached PDF and CSV). Highlights: 

- redwood-sig-retention-matrix-20261130.pdf: maps SIG/CAIQ control IDs to Redwood artifacts and retention controls. Section 3.2 details ephemeral inference logs handling and the PII redaction pipeline.
- inference-log-sample-psuedo-rows.csv: anonymized rows showing input prompt hash, timestamp, retention-tag (diagnostic/ephemeral), and redaction flags. Note we replaced any PII candidates with [REDACTED].
- keystore-disposal-cert-draft.docx (attached): proposed certification language for keystore/derived-key disposal and key-rotation timelines.

Quick clarifications: 
- For hosted accounts we recommend customers who need zero-retention opt into Private deployment + customer-managed KMS.
- Our default SOC evidence package includes logs + key-rotation ledger + deletion proofs (S3 versioned delete markers). The deletion proof is generated when a tenant requests purging; it contains timestamps and S3 deletion object ids.

Let us know what the SIG team wants changed. We can provide a separate zipped evidence bundle for your internal reviewers if preferred.

Best,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Principal, Compliance & Evidence, Redwood Inference
From: security@oncoscale.com <security@oncoscale.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: samantha@oncoscale.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: ephemeral inference logs / keystore disposal

Diego/Irene — thanks for the materials. Quick feedback from our SIG reviewers: 

1) The mapping looks good, but they want explicit language we can include in a SOC attestation letter stating: “Redwood generates and stores deletion-proof metadata for tenant purge operations, and provides cryptographic hashes of deleted objects upon request.” Can you confirm you can include that line in the disposal cert?

2) The sample CSV is helpful, but the reviewers asked for an additional column: "data_classification" (PII / PHI / none). They want to see how redaction decisions are logged. Can you produce an updated CSV with that column? Pseudonymization examples are fine.

3) On DocuSign — we'd prefer the certificate to be signed by legal. Is your legal team able to sign a short disposal attestation? If so, please initiate via DocuSign and let us know the link so we can route it internally.

Samantha
OncoScale Security Team
From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: security@oncoscale.com, Samantha Lin <samantha@oncoscale.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

- inference-log-sample-psuedo-rows.csv (v2) — new column data_classification included with pseudonymized PHI/PII markers and redaction flags.
- keystore-disposal-cert-draft.docx (final) — moved the SOC clause into the main body. 

I've initiated a DocuSign envelope with Legal for the disposal attestation. Signing link: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/xyz123 (also in the drive folder). Please confirm receipt and whether you'd like any additional logging artifacts (rotation ledger, S3 deletion object ids).

Thanks — we'll remain on standby for any follow-ups during your SIG review.

Diego
